card.name: Company names before Inc. or LLC
card.fires_on: The last word of a drug company's name, just before a legal ending such as Inc., LLC or S.p.A. Seen in trademark notes and contact lines in drug labels.

modes.label: Co. in company name
modes.description: The abbreviation Co after a company name and ampersand, before a period and Inc.

modes.label: Company name ending
modes.description: The closing word of a manufacturer name such as Laboratories or USA, before a legal ending.
modes.example: For more information concerning this drug, please call Fresenius Kabi<< USA>>, LLC at 1-80
